purpose: For each race on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot in ZIPs 78701, 94103 and 10001: which slider issues the office has legal authority over (with the statute, constitution or official page), and the measured local problems in those issue areas. Wording is factual only. This file makes no claims about any candidate.

roleKeys.votes_on_state_law: votes on bills in the state legislature
roleKeys.enforces_law: enforces existing law; does not write it
roleKeys.regulates: issues rules or approvals under existing law
roleKeys.administers_program: runs a program created by law
roleKeys.board_member: sits on a board that acts in this area
roleKeys.chairs_allocation_committee: chairs the body that awards the funds
roleKeys.collects_taxes_and_estimates_revenue: collects taxes and estimates revenue; does not set rates
roleKeys.manages_fund_lands: manages land held for a fund

sourceCheckKey: "fetched; text matched": the page was fetched this session and the quoted duty was found in it. "URL resolves": the page returned HTTP 200, but its text was not machine-checked. "not fetched": the citation is given but was not opened. Note: statutes.capitol.texas.gov /Docs/ URLs return the same app page for every chapter, so a 200 there does not prove the chapter exists; Texas chapter text was checked against the official text files at https://tcss.legis.texas.gov/resources/ instead.

problemSources.acs: Census ACS 2024 5-year via the Census Reporter API (api.censusreporter.org), computed the same way the repo computes ZIP metrics. Texas/California/New York state rent-burden values match the repo stateValue fields.
problemSources.bls: BLS LAUS via api.bls.gov v1, September 2026, preliminary. State series are seasonally adjusted; county series are not.
problemSources.repo: ZIP-level metrics copied unchanged from the repo (data/ballots.json, data/ny.json).

The attorney general runs the Health Care Bureau and the Medicaid Fraud Control Unit.

notes: Enforcement only; the attorney general does not write or pass laws. Statute: Executive Law sec. 63 (https://www.nysenate.gov/legislation/laws/EXC/63), which blocks automated fetches.
